text: The Mariupol sortie is over. He is quiet, even by the kitchen. Can we give him a rest?
Yes. While we prepare for Vinnytsia, check his health and upgrades. Do not skimp on what will bring you home.
Is the enemy taking a break as well?
Unfortunately, no. Helicopters and jets near the tower. But we do not send an exhausted friend into battle. Prepare first.
